mapper.select: SELECT menu_id, parent_menu_id, menu_name, screen_id, icon, sort_order, use_yn, mobile_yn, updated_at, updated_by FROM public.sys_menu ORDER BY sort_order, menu_id
SELECT menu_id FROM public.sys_menu WHERE parent_menu_id IS NULL ORDER BY menu_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE public.sys_menu SET menu_name = #{menuName}, parent_menu_id = #{parentMenuId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = #{useYn}, mobile_yn = #{mobileYn}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO si_cost.sys_role_menu_perm ( role_id, menu_id, can_read, can_create, can_update, can_delete, can_upload, can_download, can_confirm, updated_at, updated_by ) SELECT r.role_id, #{menuId}, 'N', 'N', 'N', 'N', 'N', 'N', 'N', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL FROM si_cost.sys_role r ORDER BY r.role_id
